game_title: Arithmetic Cannon – Lava River Crossing Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on cinder bats.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on cinder bats. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the damage value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the forge anvil using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The forge anvil reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the forge anvil is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The forge anvil reached with actions_used <= 22.
